Class InterceptorChain

java.lang.Object
iu.type.InterceptorChain
final class InterceptorChain extends Object
Resolves and runs the interceptors that apply to a method or constructor.

Interceptors run in the order defined by Jakarta Interceptors:

  1. default interceptors, unless excluded, by class name
  2. Interceptors declared by the target class, unless excluded by the method
  3. Interceptors declared by the method
  4. for a method, AroundInvoke methods of the target class

Within an interceptor class, methods declared by superclasses run before methods of subclasses, except where overridden. For a constructor, AroundConstruct applies to interceptor classes only; one declared by the target class itself is ignored. PostConstruct and PreDestroy callbacks are never intercepted.
